column1: # MSVC vtables of default.xex, named from their RTTI locator.
# Produced by scripts/SweepMsvcRtti.java, read-only, no oracle.
# An entry appears only when the whole chain resolves - locator, type
# descriptor, a name beginning '.?A', and a first slot pointing into an
# executable block. 1619 locator-like words failed a step; they are counted in
# the sweep summary and deliberately not named here.
# class is a best-effort undecoration and is EMPTY for templates: the mangled
# column is the authoritative name. bases are 'mangled@mdisp' in decimal.
